name: Summer BBQ Chicken with Corn
method: Toss the chicken thighs with the barbecue sauce in a bowl and leave to marinate for 15 minutes, or longer if you have time.
Mix the chopped avocado, tomatoes, salad and shredded cabbage in a large bowl. Whisk the yoghurt, oil and vinegar with a pinch of salt and pepper, pour over the salad and toss.
Put the corn in a covered bowl with a splash of water and microwave for 4 minutes.
Heat a griddle pan over a high heat until very hot, then cook the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until charred and cooked through.
Cook the corn on the griddle for 5 minutes, turning now and then, until lightly charred all over.
Serve the chicken with the salad and corn, spreading the butter over the corn with a pinch of salt.
